meta.name: muapi-product-ad-cinematic
meta.description: Cinematic 5–10s product ad from a product photo + brand brief.

copy.tagline: 把产品照片和品牌需求变成电影级短视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成高质量的产品广告视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn product photos and brand briefs into cinematic short video ads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate high-quality product ad videos.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的产品照片和品牌风格描述，先生成 4 张不同风格的静态画面供你挑选，再把你选中的画面放大、制作成 5–10 秒的短视频，并配上背景音乐。
howto.when: 当你提到“产品广告”、“商业广告”、“电影感广告”或“产品视频”等关键词，并给出产品图片和品牌风格要求时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这张产品图做一个 6 秒的电影感广告，风格要奢华。
say.note: Claude 会生成 4 张画面供你挑选，然后制作视频。

say.text: 给这个产品做一个活泼风格的商业广告视频，时长 8 秒。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤生成并让你选择画面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates 4 static hero frame variants from your product photo and brand brief, lets you pick one, then upscales it, creates a 5–10 second cinematic video, and adds background music.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "product ad", "commercial", "cinematic ad", or "product video", and provide a product image and brand style description.

say_en.text: Make a 6-second cinematic ad from this product photo with a luxury vibe.
say_en.note: Claude will generate 4 frames for you to choose from, then produce the video.

say_en.text: Create a playful commercial video for this product, 8 seconds long.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the steps and ask you to pick a frame.
